title: Dynamic Models for Confidence and Response Time Distributions
text: package provides functions fitting, predicting, simulating data based Sequential Sampling Models Decision-Making Confidence Judgments. uses formula-based interface allow easy specification experimental manipulations (e.g., ~ SAT). repository branch (integration) significant architectural rework original dynConfiR package, completed part Interdisciplinary Project (IDP). features refactored Cpp backend modular R-side architecture. package includes density functions decision, confidence, response time outcomes several models, including: - Dynamic Visibility, Time, Evidence model (dynaViTE) - Dynamic Weighted Evidence Visibility (dynWEV) - Two-Stage Signal Detection (2DSD) - Independent Partially-Correlated Race Models (IRM/PCRM) (see Hellmann et al. 2023 details, preprint available )

title: Dynamic Models for Confidence and Response Time Distributions
text: module contains R code manages user interface, data preparation, optimization control. Exported Functions: fit_rtconf_models_formula main parallel wrapper fitting multiple subjects models. calls fit_rtconf_formula individual fit. Sets parameter grid grid search. Calls Cpp grid_search_worker parallel find best starting points. Calls Cpp nlopt_optimizer parallel n_attempts best starting points. Formats final result. utils_validate_args.R: Provides user-friendly error messages validating function arguments execution. utils_get_context.R: Creates context objects (one R, one Cpp) pass state application. utils_process_input_data.R: Cleans, validates, transforms input data.frame dependent_vars matrix. utils_get_model_params.R: Sorts parameters fixed, estimated, manipulated categories sets model-specific defaults. utils_build_model_matrix.R: Uses stats::model.matrix build predictor matrix creates index mappings Cpp. utils_setup_jobs.R & utils_setup_parallel.R: Configure future parallel backend (flat nested) prepare list model-subject jobs. utils_fill_thresholds.R: post-processing helper fill un-fittable confidence thresholds subject use ratings.

title: Dynamic Models for Confidence and Response Time Distributions
text: module, written Cpp Rcpp, handles high-performance computation. designed “state-aware” backend receives necessary data R single DTO. - Entry Points: grid_search_worker nlopt_optimizer two Rcpp exported functions called directly R. receive DTO manage Cpp-side optimization process. - Optimization Logic: neg_loglikelihood core objective function. iterates trials, calling get_trial_params get parameters specific trial summing log-likelihood densities. - Cpp Utils Submodule: - optimization_context.hpp/.cpp: Defines OptimizationContext class, main Data Transfer Object (DTO) R. holds constant data (model matrix, dependent variables, parameter mappings) entire fit. - ModelParameters: Cpp struct defined optimization_context.hpp holds parameters single trial transformations. - logger.hpp: utility bridges Cpp logging calls back R logger package, allowing Cpp code log file R log layout. - validate_params.h: Cpp-side helper validating parameter sets used density functions. - Densities: core g_minus_WEVmu density function (others, e.g., density_2DSD) called neg_loglikelihood. - NLopt Integration: Cpp optimizer uses nloptr R package link C API headers NLopt library. avoids needing bundle entire NLopt library package. (see similar example ).

title: Dynamic Models for Confidence and Response Time Distributions
text: improve onboarding development workflow collaborators: - Continuous Integration: package includes GitHub Action workflow (.github/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml) automatically runs R CMD check Windows, macOS, Ubuntu every push pull request main integration branches. process now incorporates initial setup testthat suite, runs simple sanity check verify package properly builds links Cpp backend. enhances CI confirming package installable also correctly compiled. - IDE Setup: scripts/configure_clangd.R script generates .clangd file. provides Cpp auto-completion, linting, error-checking IDEs, making Cpp development much easier.

title: Dynamic Models for Confidence and Response Time Distributions
text: rework focused building robust, formula-based architecture dynaViTE/dynWEV/2DSD model family. following items key next steps: - Extend Race Models: Integrate existing Race Models (IRM/PCRM) density functions C++ OptimizationContext update R-side fit_rtconf_formula_dispatcher support . - Implement Optimizers: nlopt_optimizer.cpp file supports Nelder-Mead bobyqa. extended support optimization algorithms (e.g., L-BFGS-B). - Optimize Grid Search: Refine initial grid search strategy. current implementation uses simple random search (rnorm) find starting points. improved example incorporating domain-specific parameter priors cover parameter space efficiently. - End--End Benchmarking: Enhance fit_rtconf_models_formula wrapper systematically track report wall-clock time model-subject fit, providing simple framework performance profiling. - Improve Nested Parallelism: Make nested parallel plan (n_cores = c(outer, inner)) robust, particularly handling error propagation, logging, potential orphaned processes inner workers. - Refactor Density Interface: ModelParameters struct currently uses Adapter Pattern (via to_density_vector method) communicate legacy density functions. interface refactored density functions can accept ModelParameters struct directly. - CI/CD Unit Tests: minimal testthat suite added verify core build Cpp linking. initial setup expanded adding tests validate different functionalities package (pre-processing, density functions, …).
